description: This file defines a PHP class 'TerminationReasonConfigurationSearchFilterParams' in the OrangeHRM project, used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering termination reason configurations, specifically allowing sorting by the 'tr.name' field.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams to specify filtering parameters for termination reason configurations, with a default sort field of 'tr.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field to 'tr.name'.
